verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a REST API for setting up and scaling pipelines and managing the account programmatically, plus Connect Cards. An official MCP server adds read/write/delete scopes and connection copying, so a broad programmatic surface clearly exists. However, nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates full UI parity: several capabilities are described only as dashboard actions (Hybrid Deployment Agent creation and token regeneration, Proxy Agent views), and one developer reports the APIs fail randomly. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that dashboard-only features (agents, alerts, transformations, Quickstart models) are API-exposed, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of API completeness and reliability.
